district_name: Mill River Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(C) inventory: Mill River Unified Union Supervisory District -- the Mill River Unified Union School District is its own supervisory district (member towns: Clarendon, Shrewsbury, Tinmouth, Wallingford). Formed under a 2006 State Board Final Report (not Act 46); operates PK-12.
Mill River Unified Union School District (official site).

board.org_name: Mill River Unified Union School Board

sources.note: Mill River UUSD members page (official): the current 11-member roster by town -- Clarendon 4 (Len Doucette, Dave Potter, Rich Clark, Carol Geery, Chair), Shrewsbury 2 (Kimberly Williams, Stephen Abatiell), Tinmouth 1 (Josh Squier), Wallingford 4 (Ned Ullrich, Grey Wicker, Sarah Wicker, David Cornwell). The district was formed under the Final Report approved by the State Board on December 19, 2006 (quoted in the Town of Clarendon 2006 Town Report): seats apportioned by population share x 9 (minimum one per town, census-adjusted) and "school board members from each town will be elected by the voters of that town" -- town-only electorates. FLAG: the 2006 formula applied to the recent census yields 10 seats (Wallingford 3) against the observed 11; the instrument producing the current allocation was not located (missing: the Articles of Agreement as currently in force).

Town of Shrewsbury 2025 Annual Town Report (official): "MILL RIVER UNIFIED UNION SCHOOL DISTRICT BOARD MEMBERS, 3 Years: Kimberly Williams -- [Term Expires] 2028; Steve Abatiell (interim) -- 2027." No term expirations are published for the Clarendon, Tinmouth or Wallingford members in any fetched source (missing: the February 26, 2026 annual meeting warning / the towns' March 3, 2026 certificates).

Town of Wallingford Selectboard minutes, March 17, 2025 (official): the selectboard recommended David Cornwell's appointment to the open Wallingford seat on the Mill River board (minutes also print "Cornell"; the district page's Cornwell governs). Separately, a Clarendon seat was filled by appointment in April 2025 with the appointee unnamed in every fetched official source -- Dave Potter and Rich Clark are the two Clarendon members whose seating route is not individually documented, so one Clarendon membership may be an appointment misclassified as elected (flagged, not guessed).

directors.note: Appointed spring 2025 to the open Wallingford seat "until next March" (Wallingford Selectboard minutes, March 17, 2025).
